snippet.title: INDY 500 KASCO 1969
snippet.description: Uses three glass discs,(two broken hence lines across the road) and photocells mounted on driver car. Engine sound is created by a segmented disc interrupting a photocell. Crash sound is created by a solenoid striking a suspended brass sheet, picked up by a phono cartridge.
